Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. M.S. Pal, learned Sr. Advocate assisted by Mr. 
Sachin Veer Singh, learned Counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Narain Dutt, learned S.C. with Mr. P.P. Bhatt, 
learned B.H. for the State.
3. Misc. Application (IA/3/2026) is allowed by accepting 
on record the rejoinder affidavit filed by petitioner. 
4. The matter is today listed on Urgency Application 
(IA/4/2026).
5. The respondent-State has relied upon G.O. No.1178/ 
Personnel-2/2005 dated 30.05.2005 issued by Department 
of Personnel Section-2, on the basis of which services of 
petitioner were dispensed with after his conviction. The 
said G.O. dated 30.05.2005 is not legible, while the typed 
copy annexed therewith contained several typographical 
errors. 
6. In such view of the matter, the respondents shall file 
neat and legible copy of G.O. dated 30.05.2005 by the next 
date.
7. List on 21.09.2026.
8. Urgency application stands disposed of accordingly. 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 11.08.2026 R.Dang
